crossRefs.note: Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed…
I just want to learn this from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?
Therefore when Paul and Barnabas had no small discord and discussion with them, they appointed Paul and Barnabas, and…
Now I say this that no one may delude you with persuasiveness of speech.
Beloved, while I was very eager to write to you about our common salvation, I was constrained to write to you exhorting…
But when I saw that they didn’t walk uprightly according to the truth of the Good News, I said to Peter before them…
So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?
In him you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation—in whom, having also believed, you…
because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the…
For this cause we also thank God without ceasing, that when you received from us the word of the message of God, you…

translations.web: to whom we gave no place in the way of subjection, not for an hour, that the truth of the Good News might continue with you.
translations.bsb: We did not give in to them for a moment, so that the truth of the gospel would remain with you.
translations.kjv: To whom we gave place by subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.
translations.asv: to whom we gave place in the way of subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.
